# SwiftUI

`FlareIMUI` ships through SwiftPM and uses Dynamic Type, safeAreaInset, and accessibility traits.

## Installation

Use the [installation guide](/en/guide/install) and COMPATIBILITY.md for versions, platform minimums, and package names.

## Basic Usage

~~~swift
import FlareIMUI
ButtonView(label: "New message", action: startConversation)
~~~

## State

The host owns state and passes it explicitly. Components do not duplicate SDK data or start network requests.

## Configuration

Complex components use defaults + capabilities + host configuration; focused primitives keep a small controlled API.

## Localized copy

`FlareStrings()` uses the Chinese defaults; `.english` selects the English preset. Install copy once with `.flareStrings(...)` on the root view. Customize through a typed configuration closure, or mutate a copy of the English preset. Both strings and formatters remain writable with copy-on-write isolation. The 2.0 RC replaces the oversized named-argument initializer with the form below; do not construct `FlareStringsTable` directly.

~~~swift
let copy = FlareStrings { strings in
    strings.send = "Send"
    strings.readTab = { "Read (\($0))" }
}
ContentView().flareStrings(copy)

var brandedEnglish = FlareStrings.english
brandedEnglish.send = "Send securely"
ContentView().flareStrings(brandedEnglish)
~~~

## Generation and validation

Edit Chinese defaults on the corresponding `FlareStringsTable` properties, English text in `strings/en.json`, and formatter rules in `strings/en-formats.json`. Run `npm run generate`, `npm run check:strings`, and `npm run check:generated`. On macOS, run `cd packages/ios-im-ui && swift test` to validate real compilation and the full native suite.

## Callbacks / Events

Every side effect returns through callbacks, events, or intents; failure and offline states retain recovery.

## Slots / Builders

Replace only targeted Header, Footer, Leading, Trailing, Empty, Loading, Error, Message Renderer, Composer Action, and Navigation Item regions.

## Theme

Generate from tokens/tokens.json and connect to the native theme environment; six brands and Light/Dark share semantic roles.

## Responsive

PC, tablet, and mobile/H5 share semantics while using hover/keyboard/context menus or touch/long press/bottom sheets natively.

## Accessibility

Validate keyboard or platform focus, screen readers, Large Text, High Contrast, Reduced Motion, and 48 logical-pixel touch targets.

## Platform Notes

The website does not simulate native visuals. Vue preview validates Web behavior; Flutter, Compose, and SwiftUI visual regression remains in native test projects.
